articles.title: Romania extends pre-trial detention of far-right politician Calin Georgescu
articles.summary: The Bucharest Court of Appeal extended the pre-trial detention of far-right politician Calin Georgescu by thirty days during an investigation into an alleged one point one million euro fraud case. Prosecutors stated that Georgescu and two associates defrauded a businessman under the pretense of securing a credit line. Georgescu denied all wrongdoing, alleging the investigation is politically motivated, while hundreds of his supporters protested outside the court building.
articles.description: The Bucharest court has extended the pre-trial detention of Calin Georgescu by 30 days, appealing a lower court ruling.

articles.headline: Instagram head Adam Mosseri says AI negativity will worsen
articles.title: Adam Mosseri says negativity around AI is ‘going to get worse’
articles.summary: Instagram head Adam Mosseri stated in a podcast interview that public frustration, anger, and anxiety regarding artificial intelligence will continue to escalate over the coming years, driven largely by a fear of job displacement and being left behind. Speaking on the Colin and Samir podcast, Mosseri also discussed content ranking challenges, the prevalence of misleading celebrity deepfakes, and new labeling requirements for artificial intelligence accounts on the platform.
articles.description: Asked about AI and the trend of college students booing tech CEOs at graduation ceremonies, Instagram head Adam Mosseri acknowledged in an interview that a lot of people really don't like AI, and it's not just young people and creatives. Appearing on the Colin and Samir podcast to talk about the launch of widescreen and […]

articles.headline: UN experts condemn excessive police force during student protests in France
articles.title: UN experts sound alarm at excessive use of force in French student protests
articles.summary: United Nations human rights experts expressed concern on Wednesday over the disproportionate use of force and mass arrests of minors during nationwide student demonstrations in France. Protests began in mid-September over high school conditions, living costs, and budget cuts under President Emmanuel Macron, drawing 410,000 participants on Saturday according to the interior ministry. The crackdown left multiple injuries, including a teenager who lost a hand in Lille.
articles.description: UN experts have condemned police crackdowns, warning they deter demonstrators from exercising their rights.

articles.title: What does Israel's election mean for Gaza and the wider world?
articles.description: The BBC's diplomatic correspondent James Landale reports from Jerusalem as ballots are cast.

articles.headline: Data center backlash unites American voters and shapes elections
articles.title: Data center backlash is uniting America
articles.summary: Rapid data center construction has sparked widespread local opposition and emerged as a major wedge issue in 2026 congressional and gubernatorial campaigns across states including Texas and Florida. Candidates from both parties are proposing measures such as stricter environmental regulations, moratoriums, and requirements for developers to cover energy and water infrastructure costs.
articles.description: If there's one issue that seems to activate all kinds of voters in 2026, it's data centers. The rapid buildout of these massive server storage facilities - and the infrastructure construction and expenses that come with them - has sparked local opposition in communities across the country and become a major issue in many congressional […]

articles.headline: Costa Rica opens new maximum-security prison built with Salvadoran assistance
articles.title: Costa Rica’s mega-prison receives first inmates
articles.summary: Costa Rica's Justice Ministry announced the intake of the first 123 inmates at the newly inaugurated High-Containment Center Against Organized Crime on October 15. Built with Salvadoran assistance on the outskirts of San Jose at a cost of $35m, the 5,100-capacity facility aims to address prison overcrowding. Justice Minister Gabriel Aguilar stated the facility supports President Laura Fernandez's firm stance against rising organized crime and drug trafficking violence.
articles.description: President Laura Fernandez inaugurated the $35m mega-prison built to house up to 5,100 inmates near San Jose.

articles.headline: Indonesian students demand action on wildfires and rising costs
articles.title: Indonesian students demand action on wildfires and rising costs
articles.description: Hundreds of Indonesian students protested against the government's handling of forest fires and rising costs.

articles.headline: Pakistan minister invites Punjab chief minister to attend conference
articles.title: Pakistan minister invites Punjab CM Mann
articles.summary: Ramesh Singh Arora, Pakistan Punjab Minister for Minority Affairs, has formally invited Indian Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann and all Punjab Assembly legislators to visit Pakistan. The invitation follows Mr. Mann's expressed desire to attend an international Punjabi conference in Lahore and visit Sikh shrines. The Kartarpur corridor, which connects Dera Baba Nanak to Darbar Sahib Gurdwara, has remained closed since May 2025 due to bilateral tensions.
articles.description: Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann had said that he wished to accept the invitation from the organisers of the Lahore International Punjabi Conference in Lahore from November 27 to 29 and would want to visit Sikh shrines in Pakistan

articles.headline: Upper caste candidates dominate Bihar legislative council election results
articles.title: Bihar MLC polls: Upper caste candidates dominate election results
articles.summary: Upper-caste candidates secured six out of eight seats in the Bihar State Legislative Council elections held on October 23, 2026. Bhumihar candidates won five seats, while a Rajput candidate won one, with victories split across ruling and opposition parties. Additionally, Other Backward Class and Extremely Backward Class candidates secured one seat each, while the opposition Congress party failed to win any of the contested positions.
articles.description: The Opposition Congress party which had put up its candidates on five seats has failed to win even a single seat in the elections

articles.headline: Flavio Bolsonaro arrives in Miami after presidential run-off election defeat
articles.title: What’s next for Brazil’s Flavio Bolsonaro after election defeat?
articles.summary: Far-right Senator Flavio Bolsonaro and his family arrived in Miami, Florida on Wednesday following his defeat in Brazil presidential run-off election against incumbent Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva. Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes had ordered him to surrender his passports amid a money laundering investigation. Meanwhile, US President Donald Trump claimed without evidence that the election was rigged.
articles.description: The far-right ally of US President Donald Trump has fled to Miami with his wife and children.

articles.headline: National Democratic Alliance secures four seats in Bihar Legislative Council polls
articles.title: Bihar MLC polls: NDA close to win 4 out of 8 seats
articles.summary: Election results for six out of eight seats have been declared in the Bihar Legislative Council polls held across graduate and teachers constituencies. The National Democratic Alliance is set to win four seats, while independent candidates and the Jan Suraaj Party also secured victories. Janata Dal United candidate Neeraj Kumar won his fourth consecutive term from the Patna Graduate constituency.
articles.description: All sitting MLCs of the Teachers constituency lost the election, whereas Janata Dal (United) candidate Neeraj Kumar retained his Patna Graduate Constituency

articles.headline: Jan Suraaj Party secures first victory in Bihar Legislative Council elections
articles.title: Bihar MLC polls: Jan Suraaj Party opens account, JD(U)'s Neeraj Kumar 'wins' Patna Graduates seat
articles.summary: The Jan Suraaj Party opened its account in the Bihar Legislative Council elections as candidate Suresh Prasad Rai defeated sitting Congress member Madan Mohan Jha on Wednesday. Polling took place on October twenty-third with a turnout of eighty-two percent in teachers constituencies and fifty-three percent in graduates seats. Leaders from various parties reacted to the outcomes while highlighting regional issues.
articles.description: In the Patna Graduates constituency, JD(U)'s Neeraj Kumar has defeated the RJD candidate, though official results for the seat are yet to be declared

articles.headline: NTK member Saattai Duraimurugan seeks anticipatory bail in Madras High Court
articles.title: NTK’s ‘Saattai’ Duraimurugan moves Madras High Court seeking anticipatory bail
articles.summary: Naam Tamilar Katchi office-bearer A. Duraimurugan approached the Madras High Court seeking anticipatory bail regarding a Chennai cyber crime case. The First Information Report stems from a complaint lodged on October third by Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam cadre A. Christopher over a YouTube video containing remarks against Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay. The petitioner argued the allegations are politically motivated and intended to curb freedom of speech.
articles.description: An FIR had been registered against him for his alleged derogatory YouTube video against Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay and Minister Aadhav Arjuna

articles.headline: SAD and AAP trade barbs over Punjab drug menace issue
articles.title: SAD-AAP trade barbs on drug menace issue in Punjab
articles.summary: Political tensions intensified in Punjab as the Aam Aadmi Party and Shiromani Akali Dal exchanged sharp accusations regarding narcotics trafficking ahead of the 2027 Assembly election. The dispute followed a supplementary chargesheet filed by the Punjab Vigilance Bureau against senior Akali Dal leader Bikram Singh Majithia, alleging he accumulated substantial wealth through illicit drug sales.
articles.description: SAD leader Bikram Singh Majithia accused Arvind Kejriwal of misleading Punjabis by giving the disproportionate assets case the label of a drug case to suppress the issue

articles.headline: Lawyers protest against judge, causing chaos at Allahabad High Court
articles.title: Furniture thrown, proceedings disrupted as lawyers’ protest against HC judge turns chaotic
articles.summary: Advocates engaged in disruptive protests inside an Allahabad High Court courtroom, throwing furniture toward the dais during a hearing conducted by Justice Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal. The demonstration erupted over allegations that a lawyer was mistreated by another judge, prompting the Bench to order a report for potential disciplinary and contempt proceedings.
articles.description: The conduct of the lawyers prompted the court to consider disciplinary and contempt proceedings against those involved

articles.headline: Stalin urges President Murmu to act against Chief Election Commissioner
articles.title: Stalin urges Murmu to initiate action against Gyanesh Kumar
articles.summary: Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam president M.K. Stalin petitioned President Droupadi Murmu to initiate parliamentary action against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. He alleged that the unauthorized deletion of millions of electors from Tamil Nadu voter rolls during a 2025 revision distorted electoral outcomes, and requested the suspension of the disputed rolls for future polls.

articles.headline: Mumbai police re-arrest 11 accused under MCOCA in actor firing case
articles.title: Tiger Shroff firing case: 11 accused re-arrested under MCOCA after court grants permission
articles.summary: Mumbai Crime Branch officials re-arrested eleven suspects under the stringent Maharashtra Control of Organised Crime Act following authorization from a special court. The accused are linked to an October 18 incident involving gunfire directed at actor Tiger Shroff’s car in Juhu, an attack allegedly orchestrated by associates of jailed gangster Lawrence Bishnoi.
articles.description: The accused were produced before the special MCOCA court on October 28, a day after the Mumbai Crime Branch invoked provisions of the Act against them

articles.headline: Kavitha threatens to block census operations over OBC column demands
articles.title: Kavitha threatens to block census operations over OBC column demand
articles.summary: Telangana Rakshana Sena chief Kalvakuntla Kavitha threatened to obstruct upcoming census activities in Telangana unless authorities implement a dedicated Other Backward Classes column with standardised caste coding. Speaking at an association meeting in Hyderabad, she urged the State government to pass a legislative resolution supporting comprehensive nationwide caste enumeration and proportionate representation.
articles.description: Hyderabad Declaration adopts nine resolutions on caste census, reservations

articles.headline: Boston federal jury convicts Rwandan American man of perjury and obstruction
articles.title: US jury convicts Rwandan American of lying about role in genocide
articles.summary: A federal jury in Boston convicted Eric Nshimiye of four counts of perjury and one charge of obstruction of justice regarding his involvement in the 1994 Rwandan genocide. Prosecutors stated the 55-year-old United States citizen lied during a 2019 trial and on immigration paperwork. Defence lawyers argued inconsistencies in witness testimonies. Nshimiye faces sentencing while his family sought a different outcome.
articles.description: Jurors heard competing witness testimony on where Eric Nshimiye was and what he was doing in April 1994.

articles.headline: Students on hunger strike in India demand restoration of student union
articles.title: Students on hunger strike in India demand restoration of student union
articles.description: Students at New Delhi’s Jamia Millia Islamia university are on hunger strike demanding a student union.

articles.headline: Microsoft ends Copilot support on LG and Samsung smart televisions
articles.title: Microsoft is ending Copilot support on smart TVs
articles.summary: Microsoft is terminating Copilot support across all smart televisions during 2026, according to an on-screen notification discovered on an LG television. The artificial intelligence assistant previously provided chat functions and content recommendations on devices made by LG and Samsung. Microsoft recently shifted the assistant toward business tools, while LG previously faced user backlash over unremovable shortcuts.
articles.description: Nearly two years after LG and Samsung announced at CES 2025 that their latest smart TVs would include access to Microsoft's Copilot, the company is ending support for the AI assistant's functionality on all TVs this year, according to a report by Windows Central. The news comes not from an official announcement from LG, Samsung, […]

articles.headline: Balad leader Sami Abu Shehadeh condemns exclusion of Arab parties in Israel
articles.title: Balad leader blasts ‘racist’ exclusion of Arab parties in Israel
articles.summary: Balad party leader Sami Abu Shehadeh has condemned Israeli political leaders for refusing to form a coalition with Arab parties despite a record performance in polls. Arab parties are projected to win 19 seats. Abu Shehadeh criticized the exclusion as racism while speaking to Al Jazeera. Meanwhile, a United Nations commission reported that Israel has continued committing genocide in Gaza.
articles.description: Elections have yielded no clear winner but opposition bloc refuses to ally with Arab parties.

articles.headline: Myanmar diplomat breaks down as he urges world to 'end our suffering'
articles.title: Myanmar diplomat breaks down as he urges world to 'end our suffering'
articles.description: Kyaw Moe Tun - Myanmar's representative to the UN - makes an emotional appeal after saying the international community had failed the country's people.

articles.headline: Border clash between Afghanistan and Pakistan kills one and injures five
articles.title: Afghan-Pakistan border clash kills one, injures five
articles.summary: A cross-border clash in the market town of Angoor Adda left one person dead and five injured on Wednesday, according to officials in Pakistan. The South Waziristan district administration blamed the incident on unprovoked mortar fire from Afghanistan, prompting Pakistani forces to respond with artillery. Pakistan and Afghanistan have experienced sporadic fighting since a truce in March following earlier conflict.
articles.description: The countries went to war earlier this year and, with no permanent resolution reached on security issues, there have been sporadic attacks since a March truce

articles.headline: MP Vikramjit Singh Sahney urges Union government to reopen Kartarpur corridor
articles.title: BJP MP seeks reopening of Kartarpur corridor, Amit Shah inaugurates exhibition to mark 25 years of Modi’s public service
articles.summary: Rajya Sabha member Vikramjit Singh Sahney urged the Union government on Wednesday to reopen the Kartarpur corridor before next month. The corridor links shrines in Punjab and Pakistan and has remained closed since the Pahalgam terror attack on April 22, 2025. Sahney raised the issue with Union Home Minister Amit Shah during an event in New Delhi marking twenty-five years of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's public service.
articles.description: Rajya Sabha member Vikramjit Singh Sahney says Prime Minister Narendra Modi deserves the Bharat Ratna for his dedication and service to nation

articles.headline: Madhya Pradesh police arrest eleventh suspect in Dewas spurious liquor case
articles.title: M.P. hooch deaths: prime accused used AI to help brew liquor at home, say police
articles.summary: Police in Dewas arrested Aman Kasliwal on October 28, 2026, for allegedly supplying chemicals used to manufacture illicit liquor linked to thirteen deaths in Chandana and Binjana villages since September 27. Officials stated that prime accused Ajay Rathore used artificial intelligence to learn mixing formulae. Meanwhile, the district excise officer was suspended for gross negligence, and top officials were transferred.
articles.description: A total of 11 people have been arrested so far, amid allegations surfacing of over 10 deaths due to spurious liquor in a month in two villages of Dewas district in Madhya Pradesh

articles.headline: Sudan war and inflation leave Khartoum families struggling to buy food
articles.title: Sudan war and inflation leave families struggling to survive in Khartoum
articles.summary: Families in Khartoum are struggling to survive amid soaring food prices and severe inflation driven by the ongoing war between the Sudanese military and the Rapid Support Forces. According to the Central Bureau of Statistics, national prices rose by twenty-eight percent in September compared to the previous year. The conflict has severely damaged infrastructure, disrupted supply chains, and forced millions from their homes.
articles.description: Soaring food prices and shrinking incomes force families in Sudan's capital to borrow money and skip meals.

articles.headline: Vedanta chairperson Anil Agarwal explores investments in West Bengal
articles.title: Vedanta chief meets Suvendu, explores investments in West Bengal
articles.summary: Vedanta Group chairperson Anil Agarwal met with Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari in Kolkata on Wednesday to explore investments worth approximately seventy thousand crore rupees in West Bengal. Agarwal stated that the company plans to invest in power generation and an aluminum smelter plant if it receives active administrative support. Adhikari noted that the proposed project in Asansol could potentially generate up to ten thousand jobs.
articles.description: Anil Agarwal says he will leave no stone unturned to invest in Bengal if the right opportunity presents itself; CM says the industrialist made a specific proposal to set up a unit in Asansol

articles.headline: Canada and European Union prepare for Montreal summit to strengthen economic ties
articles.title: Canada-EU summit: What do both sides want, and what’s at stake?
articles.summary: Canada will host the twenty-first bilateral summit with the European Union in Montreal to enhance cooperation across trade, defense, energy, and artificial intelligence. The meeting follows escalating trade tensions and tariffs imposed by United States President Donald Trump. European Council President Antonio Costa, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney will participate in the discussions.
articles.description: The EU has proposed to make Canada its first associate member amid tensions over US tariffs.

articles.headline: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar holds bilateral talks with Austrian counterpart Beate Meinl-Reisinger
articles.title: S. Jaishankar holds talks with Austrian counterpart Meinl-Reisinger
articles.summary: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar met with Austrian counterpart Beate Meinl-Reisinger in New Delhi on October 28, 2026, to discuss bilateral ties. The wide-ranging talks focused on expanding cooperation in trade, investment, infrastructure, technology, education, startups, and space. Total bilateral trade volume between the two nations stands at $2.93 billion as relations continue an upward trajectory.
articles.description: The EAM said he and Meinl-Reisinger exchanged views on global developments and their impacts

articles.headline: Vedanta Group targets fifty billion dollar revenue over the next two years
articles.title: Vedanta Group eyeing $20 billion profits over next two years: Chairman Anil Agarwal
articles.summary: Vedanta Group aims to achieve $50 billion in revenue and $20 billion in profits over the next two years, according to founder and chairman Anil Agarwal. Speaking in Kolkata, Agarwal noted current projections of $30 billion in revenue and $11 billion in profits. Recently listed Vedanta Aluminium also reported a doubling of quarterly net profit alongside significant debt reduction.
articles.description: Vedanta is targeting $11 billion in profits this year, Chairman Anil Agarwal said.

articles.headline: India and Japan commit to strengthening regional connectivity and bilateral partnerships
articles.title: MEA highlights stronger linkages between Japan and northeast India
articles.summary: India and Japan have reaffirmed their commitment to strengthening bilateral ties, according to Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal, following discussions between Bangladesh Prime Minister Tarique Rahman and Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi in Tokyo. The leaders agreed to enhance regional connectivity by advancing development at the Matarbari deep sea port in Bangladesh, which will connect directly to northeast India to support economic growth and logistics.
articles.description: After the leaders of Japan and Bangladesh agree to enhance regional connectivity, the MEA says it will also boost to the Japan-India economic partnership in India as well

articles.headline: What we know as Flávio Bolsonaro lands in US after Brazil election loss
articles.title: What we know as Flávio Bolsonaro lands in US after Brazil election loss
articles.description: The BBC's Ione Wells unpacks Bolsonaro's journey to Miami after losing Brazil's presidential election and facing a passport surrender order.

articles.headline: India secures series sweep against Zimbabwe with eight-wicket victory
articles.title: Vaishnavi’s five-for sets up India’s series sweep
articles.summary: India completed a 3-0 series sweep against Zimbabwe on Wednesday after securing an eight-wicket victory at the BCA Stadium in Vadodara. Vaishnavi Sharma claimed a maiden five-wicket haul, restricting the visitors to 131 in 39.5 overs. Pratika Rawal and Shafali Verma then guided India to the target with unbeaten fifties in seventeen overs, sealing a dominant win.

articles.headline: Former West Bengal minister Indranil Sen arrested over Durga Puja scam
articles.title: Former West Bengal minister Indranil Sen arrested in Durga Puja ticket scam
articles.summary: Kolkata Police arrested former West Bengal minister Indranil Sen on Wednesday evening in connection with a Durga Puja ticket scam involving the organisation MassArt. The arrest followed questioning by the Enforcement Directorate at the CGO Complex in Salt Lake. Investigators allege the accused falsely represented the organisation as sponsored by UNESCO to collect funds between 2022 and 2025.
articles.description: He faces allegations of financial irregularities and had been reportedly avoiding the police for a while

articles.headline: Vellore DMK councillor arrested over controversial remark on Karur stampede
articles.title: DMK councillor arrested over controversial remark on Karur stampede
articles.summary: Puzhal police arrested Vellore Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam councillor Teeta Saravanan on Wednesday after a video of him making a controversial remark regarding the Karur stampede went viral on social media. The accused allegedly made the statement during a protest following the arrest of former minister Anbil Mahesh Poyyamozhi. Authorities registered cases against him under multiple sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.
articles.description: In a video that went viral on social media, the councillor was heard saying, “If we had finished him off at Karur on that day, we wouldn’t be in this situation today.” The remark was allegedly directed at Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay, in an apparent reference to the stampede in Karur

articles.headline: Prime Minister Narendra Modi questions Congress over MLC election results
articles.title: PM questions Congress over party’s MLC election results
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi criticised the Congress party on Wednesday for failing to win any seats in Member of Legislative Council elections held using ballot papers across Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, Bihar and Karnataka. While results in several states showed victories for the Bharatiya Janata Party and regional entities, BJP leaders claimed the outcome highlights a severe lack of public support for the opposition.
articles.description: ‘MLC elections in 28 seats across four big States — Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, Bihar and Karnataka. Elections held using ballot papers. Guess how many seats Congress won? said Narendra Modi in a post on X

articles.headline: Meta considers delaying controversial new business terms past November deadline
articles.title: Meta says it’ll probably delay its controversial new business terms again
articles.summary: Meta communications head Andy Stone announced on X that the company may push the implementation of its updated business terms past November 20 following pushback from publishers regarding artificial intelligence training concerns. The proposed terms previously faced criticism from lawmakers and industry groups who argued the policies permitted content scraping, leading the company to extend consultations.
articles.description: Meta says it may push the implementation of its new business terms past November 20th as it faces backlash from publishers over concerns about AI training. In a post on X, Meta communications head Andy Stone said the company does "not plan to make policy changes without a full consultation with industry groups and leaders." […]

articles.headline: Nirmala Sitharaman criticises Rahul Gandhi over comments on Tata issue
articles.title: Nirmala Sitharaman, Rahul Gandhi spar over Tata Group leadership dispute
articles.summary: Indian Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman criticised opposition leader Rahul Gandhi on Wednesday following his remarks claiming that Tata is being criminally destroyed. Sitharaman accused Gandhi of attempting to politicise commercial and legal matters to spread toxicity and distrust against Indian industry. Gandhi had previously questioned business leaders over a leadership dispute involving Tata Trusts chairman Noel Tata and Tata Sons chairman N Chandrasekaran.
articles.description: Congress leader has questioned India Inc.’s ‘silence’ over the leadership battle at Tata Sons, saying the conglomerate is being ‘criminally destroyed’; Finance Minister hit back, saying Mr. Gandhi is seeing ‘ghosts everywhere’

articles.headline: Crime Branch makes first arrest in Kerala Public Service Commission exam scam
articles.title: Crime Branch records first arrest in PSC exam scam case; Kerala PSC chairperson questioned by SIT
articles.summary: The Crime Branch arrested former deputy secretary P. Satheesh in Kozhikode on October 28, 2026, marking the first arrest in irregularities surrounding a Kerala Public Service Commission State Planning Board examination. The Special Investigation Team also questioned PSC chairperson M.R. Baiju for five hours regarding unevaluated descriptive answers that affected candidate rankings for three senior positions.
articles.description: P. Satheesh, who was recently named an accused in the case pertaining to a Kerala State Planning Board examination, was apprehended from his home in Kozhikode to record the first arrest in the case

articles.headline: Tamil Nadu government to host investment conversion conclave in November 2026
articles.title: T.N. government plans investment conversion conclave in Nov.; Minister to visit Germany to attract investment
articles.summary: The Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam government will host its first investment conversion conclave in November 2026 under Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay to evaluate 112 signed memorandums of understanding worth over ₹1,14,812 crore. Meanwhile, Industries Minister S. Keerthana will visit Germany in the first week of November to attract further manufacturing and technology investments from German corporations.
articles.description: Sources said that the event will be held in the presence of Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay. Tamil Nadu Minister for Industries, Investment Promotion and Commerce S. Keerthana will visit Germany in the first week of November

articles.headline: Hind Rajab Foundation files UK war crimes complaint against Israeli reservist
articles.title: Israeli soldier visiting UK faces war crimes complaint
articles.summary: The Hind Rajab Foundation filed a criminal complaint in the United Kingdom against Israeli reservist Lidor Dafna over alleged war crimes linked to the demolition of a flour-producing facility in Gaza. The Brussels-based organisation utilised self-published social media footage to build its case, testing international legal mechanisms amid ongoing debates regarding universal jurisdiction and accountability for actions taken during the conflict.
articles.description: New UK war crimes complaint against an Israeli soldier highlights a global legal campaign to end systemic impunity.

articles.headline: Control room activated in Bhadrachalam as Bhadradri Kothagudem reviews cyclone preparedness
articles.title: Cyclone Arnab: Control room activated in Bhadrachalam, preparedness reviewed
articles.summary: A control room was established at the Bhadrachalam sub-Collector’s office on October 28, 2026, as intermittent drizzle affected Bhadradri Kothagudem and Khammam districts under the influence of Cyclone Arnab. Sub-Collector Mrinal Shreshtha reviewed emergency coordination with police, fire services, and disaster response forces while local schools and colleges remained closed as a precautionary measure.

articles.headline: India requires $220 billion in investment for green power transition by fiscal year 2030
articles.title: India needs $220 billion for green power transition by FY30
articles.summary: Union Ministry of New and Renewable Energy Secretary Santosh Sarangi announced on October 28, 2026, that India needs $220 billion between fiscal years 2027 and 2030 for renewable energy generation, transmission, and green technologies. Speaking ahead of the Bharat Renewable Energy Summit and Expo 2026, he detailed that solar energy and transmission infrastructure require the largest shares of funding.
articles.description: Speaking at the press curtain raiser of the the Bharat Renewable Energy Summit & Expo (2026), Mr. Sarangi mentioned that India had secured private investment of $64 billion in the sector.

articles.headline: Kylian Mbappe faces backlash in China over controversial Mao Zedong remarks
articles.title: What is the controversy between Real Madrid’s Kylian Mbappe and China?
articles.summary: Real Madrid forward Kylian Mbappe faced severe commercial and state media blowback in China following a resurfaced video showing him making light of a caricature depicting him as former Chinese leader Mao Zedong. Chinese brands Dongpeng and Mengniu swiftly severed ties with the French footballer. Although Mbappe issued a formal apology on Tuesday, the Chinese foreign ministry acknowledged the statement as state television suspended La Liga broadcasts.
articles.description: The French superstar's comments about Mao Zedong have drawn the ire of China, a lucrative market for sports teams.

articles.headline: Israel defense minister condemns Gadi Eisenkot over military resistance call
articles.title: Israel defence minister slams Eisenkot's call for military to resist PM
articles.summary: Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz strongly criticized opposition figure Gadi Eisenkot on Wednesday after the former military chief urged armed forces to defy potential post-election directives from Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu regarding Iran. Katz denounced the statement as anti-democratic during a political dispute following the October 27 election involving Netanyahu's threatened military strikes against Tehran.
articles.description: Israel Katz said that Gadi Eisenkot's comments were the latest in a campaign of lies

articles.headline: Hyundai India reports twenty-four percent profit decline for second quarter
articles.title: Hyundai India Q2 net profit falls 24% to ₹1,196 crore on high commodity cost
articles.summary: Hyundai Motor India Limited announced a twenty-four percent year-on-year drop in standalone net profit to one thousand one hundred ninety-six crore rupees for the quarter ending September 30, 2026, driven by rising commodity costs. Managing Director Tarun Garg noted that total sales reached a record two hundred nineteen thousand seventy-two units, while operating revenue increased nineteen percent to twenty thousand six hundred ninety-six crore rupees.
articles.description: The second half would see accelerated momentum, with the launch of the Bayon marking the beginning of the company’s “golden product cycle

articles.headline: Father grieving 6 children wants Pastor Mackenzie ‘locked away for life’
articles.title: Father grieving 6 children wants Pastor Mackenzie ‘locked away for life’

articles.headline: Larsen and Toubro targets fifteen lakh crore order book by 2031
articles.title: L&T aims to nearly double order book to Rs 15 lakh crore by 2031
articles.summary: Engineering conglomerate Larsen and Toubro plans to expand its order book to fifteen lakh crore rupees by 2031, supported by growth in energy, manufacturing, and international markets. Finance President R Shankar Raman stated on Wednesday that the firm anticipates a fifteen percent annual growth rate from its current valuation, with international operations in the Middle East projected to contribute equally with domestic projects.
articles.description: Company focus on energy, manufacturing, electrolysers, date centres as future areas of growth.

articles.headline: Gulf nations pursue diplomatic engagement with Iran to prevent broader conflict
articles.title: Are GCC countries looking for a regional security pact with Iran?
articles.summary: Diplomats from Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, Turkiye, and Qatar met with Iranian officials in Tehran on Monday to avert renewed conflict amid fears of United States military strikes and Houthi attacks. Omani Foreign Minister Badr Albusaidi proposed a regional security framework during a University of Cambridge visit, though analysts remain skeptical due to deep-seated mistrust and unresolved disagreements between Washington and Tehran.
articles.description: Observers say diverging views are unlikely to turn current diplomatic efforts into a lasting infrastructure.

articles.headline: XAI offers to buy homes in exchange for dropping lawsuits
articles.title: xAI is buying out homeowners who promise not to sue over data center noise
articles.summary: Elon Musk's artificial intelligence company is offering to purchase hundreds of homes in Southaven, Mississippi, through a subsidiary named MZX, provided property owners release claims related to a local noise lawsuit. According to reports, the legal action targets a nearby data center and gas-fired turbines emitting constant noise. The company faces additional environmental penalties and legal pressure from the National Association for the Advancement of Colored People.
articles.description: A subsidiary of Elon Musk's xAI is offering to buy up homes in a Mississippi neighborhood, as long as residents don't join a lawsuit targeting the company's nearby data center and power plant, according to a report from The Guardian. A realtor going door-to-door in the Southaven neighborhood reportedly told one resident that xAI plans […]

articles.headline: Arab-led parties win record seats in Israeli elections
articles.title: Why Arab parties may not be the ‘kingmakers’ in this Israeli election
articles.summary: Arab-led political factions in Israel are projected to secure a record seventeen seats in the Knesset following recent legislative voting. While exit polls indicate these parties could influence coalition formation, observers note that long-standing ideological vetoes from major Jewish political blocs continue to limit their partnership potential and direct governmental influence, despite previous historical precedents of collaboration.
articles.description: Exit poll projections show that if Eisenkot’s bloc teamed up with Arab parties, they could potentially unseat Bibi.

articles.headline: India and Mexico sign terms for preferential trade talks
articles.title: India and Mexico sign Terms of Reference for preferential trade agreement negotiations to begin
articles.summary: India and Mexico signed official terms of reference to initiate negotiations on a preferential trade agreement during a meeting abroad. Indian Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal and Mexican Undersecretary Luis Rosendo Gutiérrez Romano advanced discussions following an initial agreement between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and President Claudia Sheinbaum. The framework focuses on market access, regulatory cooperation, and economic opportunities across multiple strategic industrial sectors.
articles.description: Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal visited Mexico for the signing. The two sides also discussed a possible business delegation from Mexico visiting India in the first quarter of 2027

articles.headline: Flavio Bolsonaro travels to Ecuador after fleeing Brazil following defeat
articles.title: Brazil’s Flavio Bolsonaro lands in Florida after election defeat
articles.summary: Defeated right-wing presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro traveled to Ecuador after fleeing Brazil through Argentina, according to government statements. The 45-year-old departed from Puerto Iguazu on a private flight despite a Supreme Court ban on leaving the country. Bolsonaro remains under investigation for corruption and money laundering, and faces the impending loss of his parliamentary immunity following his runoff election defeat to Mr. Lula.
articles.description: His plane touched down at Opa-Locka Executive Airport outside Miami after flying from Argentina with a stopover in Ecuador, as speculation had swirled for days over his whereabouts.

articles.headline: Iran intensifies domestic crackdown amid foreign espionage threats
articles.title: Espionage threats blur lines between security and dissent in Iran
articles.summary: Iranian authorities have accelerated judicial punishments and mass arrests following security vulnerabilities exposed by recent military conflicts with the United States and Israel. Human rights organizations report a sharp rise in executions and detentions targeting dissidents, journalists, and protesters. Officials state these measures defend against foreign hybrid warfare, while critics argue the government uses security concerns to suppress internal political opposition and independent reporting.
articles.description: Iran is using the threat of spy networks to detain and execute political opponents, analysts say.

articles.headline: UK deploys three nuclear deterrent submarines simultaneously
articles.title: Why are three of the UK’s four nuclear deterrent submarines at sea?
articles.summary: The United Kingdom has deployed three of its four Vanguard-class nuclear-armed submarines at sea concurrently for the first time in over five years. Navy sources described the deployment as unusual while the fourth vessel undergoes maintenance. The action follows recent statements from Defence Secretary Wes Streeting urging Britain to prepare for potential conflict within one thousand days amid heightened international security tensions.
articles.description: The deployment marks the first time in years that three Vanguard-class vessels have been at sea at the same time.

articles.headline: Spanish football federation postpones Copa del Rey matches following train crash
articles.title: Spanish football postpones 24 Copa del Rey games after train crash
articles.summary: The Royal Spanish Football Federation postponed twenty-four Copa del Rey games scheduled for Wednesday in solidarity with the victims of a tragic train accident in central Spain. The high-speed collision resulted in at least thirty fatalities and approximately eighty injuries. Clubs across the country, including FC Barcelona and Real Madrid, expressed profound sorrow while authorities worked to establish a revised tournament schedule following the disaster.
articles.description: Real Madrid and Barcelona offer messages of support following train crash as Spanish football orders Copa postponement .

articles.headline: Lula comeback in Brazil dents Trump ambitions for Latin America
articles.title: Lula's comeback in Brazil dents Trump's ambitions for Latin America
articles.summary: Left-wing Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva secured an election victory marked by nationalist defiance against United States interference, complicating Washington's regional strategy under President Donald Trump. Although bilateral relations previously thawed, ongoing disputes over rare earth minerals, trade tariffs, technology policies, and diplomatic disagreements threaten to reignite tensions between the two nations.
articles.description: The Trump-Lula relationship may have thawed, but several issues could reignite tensions between the two leaders.

articles.headline: L&T breaks ground on 52 MW data centre for Chennai AI campus
articles.title: L&T begins expansion of Chennai AI infrastructure campus with 52 MW data centre
articles.summary: Larsen and Toubro commenced construction on a fifty-two-megawatt data centre in Chennai through its digital infrastructure business, Vyoma.AI, expanding the existing Kancheepuram campus. The facility will support advanced artificial intelligence workloads and follows a previous agreement with Together AI to deploy ten thousand NVIDIA graphics processing units, advancing the nation's digital infrastructure and sustainable energy goals.
articles.description: New facility adds to existing, operational 30 MW centre as Vyoma.AI targets over 250 MW of data centre capacity across India

articles.headline: Real Madrid issues apology to China over Kylian Mbappe dictator remark
articles.title: Real Madrid apologise to Chinese people for Mbappe’s Mao ‘dictator’ remark
articles.summary: Spanish football club Real Madrid issued a formal apology to the Chinese public after French player Kylian Mbappe referred to former leader Mao Zedong as a dictator during a podcast appearance. The remarks prompted immediate fallout in China, leading broadcasters to cancel match coverage, brands to terminate partnerships, and La Liga officials to form a crisis unit to address potential financial repercussions in the region.
articles.description: Mocking Mao Zedong is taboo in China, which is a lucrative market for players and teams such as Kylian Mbappe's Real.

articles.headline: Expert panel recommends winding up Kerala Infrastructure Investment Fund Board
articles.title: On the question of KIIFB’s future
articles.summary: An expert panel established by Keralam's government has recommended winding up the Kerala Infrastructure Investment Fund Board and absorbing its functions into the state administration. The committee's report, submitted to the State Assembly, concluded that the special purpose vehicle lost its primary purpose after its borrowing functions were integrated directly into the state budget.
articles.description: An expert panel constituted by Keralam’s UDF government to review the functioning of KIIFB has recommended winding it up and absorbing its functions into the State government, prompting a closer look at the merits of off-budget borrowings by States and the need to boost public investment in Keralam

articles.headline: Victims of Jordan’s air strikes in Syria
articles.title: Victims of Jordan’s air strikes in Syria
articles.description: Jordan’s air strikes in southern Syria killed at least seven people, including three children. Here are their stories.

articles.headline: Israel faces political standoff following national elections without outright majority
articles.title: Israel elections: Understanding how Knesset polls work vs India’s system
articles.summary: Israel entered a political standoff following the October 27 national election after exit polls showed Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and rival Gadi Eisenkot locked in a tight race. Neither camp secured an outright majority in the 120-seat Knesset, requiring coalition negotiations. President Isaac Herzog will consult parliamentary factions to assign a lawmaker the task of forming a government.
articles.description: Israel’s political clash after the October 27 national vote pits Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu against former military chief Gadi Eisenkot in a neck-and-neck fight to form a government, as neither major bloc won a 61-seat majority in the 120-seat Knesset

articles.headline: Yair Golan calls on Israeli opposition bloc to form government with Arab parties
articles.title: Israel polls: Golan urges Eisenkot's bloc to form government with Arab parties to oust Netanyahu
articles.summary: Democratic Party leader Yair Golan urged opposition figures led by Gadi Eisenkot to partner with Arab-led parties to replace Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu following recent elections. Golan emphasised that Arab citizens' votes carry equal weight, though opposition allies remain divided over coalition cooperation. Partial results indicated Netanyahu's bloc secured fifty-four seats while opposition groups held various combinations.
articles.description: Several allies in the Opposition's change bloc have rejected the proposal to include Arab parties in a governing coalition, while some have also ruled out relying on their support from outside

articles.headline: Jio Platforms prepares for record stock market debut in India
articles.title: India's largest share sale could end cheap mobile internet for millions
articles.summary: Jio Platforms, backed by Meta and Google and owned by billionaire Mukesh Ambani, is set for a historic 3.2 billion dollar initial public offering in India. Analysts warn that the stock market debut could end the era of ultra-cheap mobile data tariffs as the company answers to minority shareholders and focuses on increasing average revenue per user.
articles.description: Jio's IPO promises a windfall for investors, but could signal the end of cheap mobile data for millions.

articles.headline: Texans oppose data center expansion amid growing environmental and economic concerns
articles.title: Voters in Texas agree: They hate data centers
articles.summary: Voters across political lines in Texas increasingly oppose data center developments due to mounting water consumption, tax subsidies, and rising electricity bills. A coalition named We the People Texas represents approximately one million voters demanding restrictions. Governor Greg Abbott faces political pressure as grassroots groups successfully delay projects and warn lawmakers about voter backlash in upcoming elections.
articles.description: Ask Texas NAACP president Gary Bledsoe what it's been like to see data center developers descend upon Austin and its surrounding suburbs and he can rattle off project after project facing opposition from locals. There's the fight in Taylor over plans to build a data center at a site that's supposed to be a park. […]

articles.headline: Industrial AI systems balance plant autonomy with human operational oversight
articles.title: Pairing industrial AI autonomy and human control
articles.summary: Living digital twins combine dynamic plant representations with control systems, enabling factories to automate adjustments and approach industrial homeostasis. According to AVEVA chief product officer Rob McGreevy, human oversight remains vital for defining limits and monitoring alignment. Meanwhile, manufacturer surveys show growing adoption alongside significant concerns over operational risk and regulatory gaps.

articles.headline: Israeli voters: hope and despair as election ballots are counted
articles.title: Israeli voters: hope and despair as election ballots are counted
articles.description: Israeli voters in Tel Aviv expressed mixed emotions as ballots were counted after the election.

articles.headline: Real Madrid apologises to Chinese public following Kylian Mbappe's remarks
articles.title: Real Madrid apologise to Chinese people over Mbappe's Mao 'dictator' comment
articles.summary: Real Madrid issued a formal apology on October 28, 2026, regarding comments made by French forward Kylian Mbappe referencing late Chinese leader Mao Zedong as a dictator. Chinese brands including Mengniu and Shanghai Milkground Food Tech halted partnerships following the remarks. China's Foreign Ministry stated that authorities take the player's apology seriously amidst strict social taboos surrounding modern Chinese history.
articles.description: Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said: "We take seriously the apology ‌that the person has made"

articles.headline: TVS Motor plans consumer finance demerger after reporting record quarterly revenue
articles.title: TVS Motor to demerge consumer finance business; reports record quarterly revenue
articles.summary: TVS Motor Company announced plans on October 28, 2026, to demerge its consumer finance operations into a separate holding company to enhance strategic autonomy. The restructuring follows record quarterly revenue of ₹17,103 crore for the September quarter of fiscal year 2027, alongside a fifty-two percent surge in net profit to ₹1,377 crore and total vehicle sales reaching 1.9 million units.
articles.description: Automaker reports record quarterly revenue of ₹17,103 crore and a 52% increase in profit after tax to ₹1,377 crore

articles.headline: India establishes regulatory framework to introduce transparent electronic mineral exchanges
articles.title: A new ore-der: Can India’s Mineral Exchanges fix the price game?
articles.summary: India has formulated new rules under the Mines and Minerals Development and Regulation Act to establish electronic mineral exchanges governed by the Indian Bureau of Mines. The digital marketplace aims to replace fragmented negotiations with transparent, demand-driven pricing for bulk minerals like iron ore, ultimately enhancing industrial competitiveness and supporting critical manufacturing sectors.
articles.description: India’s proposed mineral exchanges aim to fix price transparency, boost liquidity, and create credible domestic benchmarks for ores like iron ore and beyond

articles.headline: Congress demands government action to address economic inequality and household debt
articles.title: Growing economic inequality one of nation's most pressing concerns, government must act: Congress
articles.summary: The Congress party demanded government intervention on October 28, 2026, to address widening economic inequality, inflation, and surging household debt. Citing data showing declining net financial savings and rising costs, party leaders Jairam Ramesh and Mallikarjun Kharge criticized Prime Minister Narendra Modi's administration for ignoring middle-class distress while the government defended its record using gross domestic product figures.
articles.description: The Opposition party also said that claims of economic development are meaningful only when their benefits reach the common man

articles.headline: Displaced families in Gaza prepare for a fourth winter in damaged tents
articles.title: Families brace for a fourth winter of wind, rain and floods in Gaza’s camps
articles.summary: Displaced residents in Gaza City face another winter in worn-out tents without adequate shelter as freezing temperatures and storms approach. Mohammed al-Jamal and Khitam Salman report that damaged tarpaulins and high repair costs leave their families vulnerable to flooding and wind. According to the United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs, over 294,000 families in Gaza need winter shelter assistance, while supply shortages hinder relief efforts.
articles.description: Gaza's impending winter is likely to lead to further devastation for Palestinians.

articles.headline: Karnataka sting operation row: What we know so far | Decode Karnataka
articles.title: Karnataka sting operation row: What we know so far | Decode Karnataka
articles.description: Two former chief ministers, a sitting chief minister and a purported sting operation - and what you get is a fresh political storm brewing in Karnataka.

articles.headline: Delegates gather in Moscow for the third Russia-Africa Summit
articles.title: Russia-Africa Summit: What is on the agenda, and why does it matter?
articles.summary: Delegates and leaders from 48 African countries gather in Moscow for the third Russia-Africa Summit, chaired by Russian President Vladimir Putin and Burundian President Evariste Ndayishimiye. The two-day meeting covers trade, security, and technology cooperation as Russia seeks to expand its influence despite Western sanctions. Analysts note the event will shape bilateral ties and partnership plans through 2029 amid growing security and military deployments across the continent.
articles.description: Moscow aims to strengthen economic and security ties with African leaders during the two-day gathering.

articles.headline: Indian stock indices decline as Reliance and IT stocks drop
articles.title: Sensex declines 353 points, dragged by Reliance, IT stocks, rising crude oil prices
articles.summary: Benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty declined on October 28, 2026, driven down by losses in Reliance Industries, information technology companies, rising crude oil prices, and caution ahead of a United States Federal Reserve policy decision. The 30-share BSE Sensex dropped 352.64 points to close at 73,246.03. Meanwhile, Jio Platforms made a strong market debut, ending nearly 27 percent higher and becoming India's second most valuable domestic firm.
articles.description: The 30-share BSE Sensex dropped 352.64 points, or 0.48%, to settle at 73,246.03, recovering most of its sharp intraday losses. During the day, it tumbled 995.1 points, or 1.35%, to 72,603.57

articles.headline: Registrar General directs officials to ensure accurate population enumeration in Andhra Pradesh
articles.title: Census 2027: Ensure every individual is counted, says Registrar General
articles.summary: Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India Mrityunjay Kumar Narayan directed census officials in Andhra Pradesh to complete the second phase of Census 2027 accurately and within strict deadlines. Addressing principal census officers on October 9, 2026, Narayan emphasized the collection of sensitive data such as religion and caste under strict confidentiality. Chief Secretary G. Sai Prasad called for a comprehensive action plan to finish enumeration across 94,983 blocks within 55 days.
articles.description: Mrityunjay Kumar Narayan asks census officials in Andhra Pradesh to complete the second phase with accuracy and within deadlines

articles.headline: LTM launches GCC Origin to help enterprises establish global capability centres
articles.title: LTM launches GCC Origin as IT firms race to serve global capability centres
articles.summary: Technology services provider LTM launched GCC Origin, a dedicated business unit designed to help enterprises establish and transform global capability centres in India. Led by Shailendra Singh and reporting to Chief Executive Officer Venu Lambu, the unit formalizes the firm's previous offerings into a standalone business. The initiative integrates artificial intelligence, infrastructure, and talent acquisition to meet rising demand from multinational corporations for specialized technology operations.
articles.description: More than a year after introducing GCC-as-a-Service, LTM creates a dedicated business unit as TCS, Infosys and other technology companies expand their offerings for multinational firms setting up in-house centres

articles.headline: Rupee drops twenty-one paise to close at ninety-five point twenty-eight
articles.title: Rupee falls 21 paise to close at 95.28 against U.S. dollar
articles.summary: The Indian rupee depreciated by 21 paise to close provisionally at 95.28 against the U.S. dollar on October 28, 2026. According to forex traders, the decline was driven by a stronger U.S. dollar and surging crude oil prices. Meanwhile, the domestic equity market saw the Sensex decline by 352.64 points to settle at 73,246.03 during the trading session.
articles.description: In the interbank foreign exchange market, the rupee opened at 95.01 against the dollar, then lost ground to touch an intra-day low of 95.29 and finally settled for the day at 95.28 (provisional), registering a decline of 21 paise over its previous close

articles.headline: Hcltech introduces artificial intelligence nano Global Capability Centre offering on Amazon Web Services
articles.title: HCLTech launches AI-powered nano GCC offering on AWS
articles.summary: HCLTech has collaborated with Amazon Web Services to unveil an artificial intelligence powered nano Global Capability Centre model tailored for enterprises. The offering integrates advisory expertise and platforms with cloud infrastructure and agentic services to facilitate transitions. Targeting Asia-Pacific first, the initiative aims to provide scalable and lower-risk operational pathways according to company executives Kiran Cherukuri and Prabhakar Appana.
articles.description: New model targets enterprises seeking to build AI-native operations through smaller, focused teams, with Asia Pacific as the first phase of rollout

articles.headline: Jamia student protest enters seventeenth day amid university property damage allegations
articles.title: Jamia student protest: Varsity alleges damage to property as stir continues for 17th day
articles.summary: Students at Jamia Millia Islamia continued their agitation for the seventeenth day demanding the restoration of the student union, despite the administration offering to hold elections within fifteen days of approving the union constitution. University officials reported property damage on campus, while political figures including Congress leader Pawan Khera expressed support for the protesting students.
articles.description: Congress said students have the right to form a students’ union and that it stands in solidarity with their struggle

articles.headline: Abhishek Sharma claims top position in International Cricket Council men's Twenty20 batting rankings
articles.title: Abhishek Sharma topples Ishan Kishan to become world No. 1 batter in T20I rankings
articles.summary: Indian opening batter Abhishek Sharma reclaimed the world number one spot in the International Cricket Council men's Twenty20 International rankings following a century against New Zealand in Wellington. He surpassed teammate Ishan Kishan, who missed matches due to injury. Meanwhile, South Africa's Marco Jansen ascended to become the top-ranked Test all-rounder and bowler, overtaking Ravindra Jadeja and Mitchell Starc.
articles.description: Abhishek hammered his fourth T20I century on October 27, smashing 113 off just 38 balls in the third T20I to power India to a six-wicket win

articles.headline: Supreme Court permits petition regarding pre-loaded caste menu for Census 2027
articles.title: Supreme Court allows petitioner seeking pre-loaded drop-down caste menu in Census to approach Registrar General
articles.summary: The Supreme Court granted the OBC Federation of India permission to approach the Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India regarding a pre-loaded drop-down menu for recognised Other Backward Classes in Census 2027 digital tools. The petitioner argued that open text fields lead to inaccuracies, while the Chief Justice noted that granular operational decisions form part of policy-making.
articles.description: Article 342A specifically identifies SEBCs; over ₹11,000 crore has been budgeted for Census 2027, but a drop-down menu is lacking, counsel for the petitioner, the OBC Federation of India, says

articles.headline: Palestinian activist Mahmoud Khalil returns to Columbia after US detention
articles.title: Palestinian activist Mahmoud Khalil returns to Columbia after US detention
articles.description: Pro-Palestinian activist Mahmoud Khalil returned to Columbia University for the first time since his US detention.

articles.headline: Human evolution continues through genetic mutations and natural selection processes
articles.title: Are humans still evolving?
articles.summary: Human populations continue to evolve through natural selection, genetic mutations, migration, and random chance, despite modern medicine altering selective pressures. Examples of human adaptation include adult lactose tolerance, high-altitude endurance among Tibetans carrying EPAS1 gene variants, and sickle-cell variant protection against severe malaria in regions where the disease is endemic.

articles.headline: Samajwadi Party leader faces criticism following participation in Buddhist conversion ceremony in Delhi
articles.title: A Delhi event unveils fault lines in the Dalit-OBC formulation of SP politics
articles.summary: Samajwadi Party spokesperson Rajkumar Bhati faced backlash from the Bharatiya Janata Party and reprimands from party leadership after reciting Dr. B.R. Ambedkar's twenty-two vows during a Buddhist ceremony in Delhi. The incident exposed internal political tensions regarding numerical caste aggregation formulas and cultural associations with Hindu deities within Uttar Pradesh politics ahead of upcoming elections.
articles.description: The brouhaha over Rajkumar Bhati reciting Ambedkar’s vows shows the limits of the SP’s revival of the Lohiate policy of numerical aggregation

articles.headline: Bharatiya Janata Party secures five seats in Uttar Pradesh Legislative Council elections
articles.title: Uttar Pradesh MLC polls: BJP wins five seats, SP three; counting underway
articles.summary: The Bharatiya Janata Party secured five seats while the Samajwadi Party won three in the Uttar Pradesh Legislative Council elections, according to officials on Wednesday. Vote counting continued across constituencies following the October 23, 2026 polling. The results serve as a crucial indicator ahead of the upcoming 2027 state assembly elections, amidst political disputes over counting procedures and candidate treatment.
articles.description: The counting is underway in Lucknow, Varanasi, Agra, Meerut, Jhansi, Bareilly and Gorakhpur

articles.headline: India bloc schedules public impeachment event for Chief Election Commissioner
articles.title: INDIA bloc's 'public impeachment' of CEC to be held at Kharge's residence on October 30
articles.summary: The Indian National Developmental Inclusive Alliance will conduct a public impeachment event targeting Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar at the official residence of Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge in New Delhi on Friday. Opposition leaders stated the programme was relocated after facing administrative obstacles at alternative venues, serving as a prelude to a larger November 1 rally addressing electoral roll revisions.
articles.description: The Congress president’s official residence was decided as the venue after the Opposition bloc’s attempts to organise the event at the Ashok Hotel and Ramlila Maidan allegedly ran into hurdles over permissions

articles.headline: Municipal Corporation issues water advisory for parts of Mumbai and Thane
articles.title: Boil, filter drinking water for seven days: BMC tells residents in parts of Mumbai, Thane and Bhiwandi
articles.summary: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation advised residents across multiple wards in Mumbai, Thane, and Bhiwandi to boil and filter drinking water for seven days. Issued on Tuesday, the precautionary directive follows water quality concerns arising from the recommissioning of a repaired reservoir at the Pise-Panjrapur supply complex, though no actual contamination has been officially confirmed by civic authorities.
articles.description: The BMC issued the warning over a possible impact on water quality following the recommissioning of a repaired reservoir at the Pise-Panjrapur water supply complex

articles.headline: Odisha districts face flash flood alerts as cyclone Arnab passes coast
articles.title: Cyclone ‘Arnab’: Flash flood alert for several southern Odisha districts amid heavy rain
articles.summary: Several southern Odisha districts are bracing for flash floods after cyclone Arnab moved past the Andhra Pradesh coast, prompting heavy rainfall and district alerts from the India Meteorological Department. State officials reported that nearly 28,000 residents have been evacuated across eight districts, with disaster response forces deployed to manage rising water levels and potential river impacts.
articles.description: Around 28,000 people had been evacuated across eight districts so far, against a planned evacuation target of 48,000, as per Odisha Special Relief Commissioner

articles.headline: Tanzania announces natural gas discovery in Mnazi Bay
articles.title: Tanzania celebrates first natural gas discovery in more than 10 years
articles.summary: Tanzania Petroleum Development Corporation and French firm Maurel and Prom discovered 223 billion cubic feet of natural gas at the Kasa-1X ST2 well in Mnazi Bay. Energy Minister Juma Homera stated the find will boost domestic supplies as demand grows. Production is scheduled to begin next month to support the East African nation's energy needs and economic activities.
articles.description: The energy minister described it as a "major milestone" for the East African nation.

articles.headline: Serbian police shoot dead attacker outside Israeli embassy
articles.title: Serbian shot dead after attacking officer outside Israeli embassy, minister says
articles.summary: Serbian police shot dead a minor who rushed an officer with two knives outside the Israeli embassy in Belgrade. Interior Minister Ivica Dacic stated the suspect was known as an Islamic State supporter. The officer sustained a minor facial wound, and authorities raised the national terrorism threat level to a red alert while investigations continue.
articles.description: Authorities say the attacker in Belgrade was an underage male who was being monitored by security services.

articles.headline: Hormuz oil spill forces closure of UAE beaches
articles.title: Hormuz oil spill forces closure of UAE beaches
articles.description: An oil spill from a damaged tanker in the Strait of Hormuz has reached the UAE’s beaches, forcing their closure.

articles.headline: Tel Aviv index drops as Israeli election exit polls show no winner
articles.title: Israel’s stock market drops as exit polls show no clear election winner
articles.summary: Israel's benchmark stock index fell up to 3.5 percent in early trading after exit polls indicated no clear parliamentary majority following the national election. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's coalition and the opposition bloc led by Gadi Eisenkot both fell short of the sixty-one seats required, with vote counting ongoing across the country.
articles.description: Benchmark Tel Aviv 125 index falls more than 3 percent amid uncertainty over who will lead the next government.

articles.headline: Lula da Silva secures fourth presidential term in Brazil amid climate challenges
articles.title: Lula’s win gives Brazil an opportunity to cement its climate leadership, but challenges remain
articles.summary: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva secured his fourth term as Brazil's president, presenting opportunities for international climate leadership alongside domestic and regional governance hurdles. Brazil continues to navigate Amazonian deforestation and regional cooperation through the Amazon Cooperation Treaty Organisation, while financial pledges for the Tropical Forest Forever Facility approach the ten billion dollar target.
articles.description: In his fourth term, the President can potentially negotiate across the divides that currently frustrate climate agreements, given his country’s status as Latin America’s largest economy, host to most of the Amazon, and its diplomatic relationships with the EU, the U.S., China, the BRICS countries and other devel

articles.headline: Israeli right-wing leaders make provocative statements during election vote counting
articles.title: Israeli right makes provocative statements as election votes are counted
articles.summary: Senior figures on the Israeli right made controversial remarks regarding Arab voters and potential settlements in Gaza as exit polls indicated Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s governing alliance faced setbacks. Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich and Netanyahu raised concerns about high turnout in Arab communities, while police arrested three individuals for alleged voter bribery. Netanyahu fell short of a majority, leaving Arab-led parties in a potentially decisive role for the next government formation.
articles.description: Netanyahu and Smotrich rail against Arab voters as rival political camps face an uncertain path to power.

articles.headline: Policeman shoots dead knife attacker outside Israeli embassy in Belgrade
articles.title: Policeman kills knife attacker outside Israeli embassy in Serbia
articles.summary: A Serbian police officer fatally shot an unidentified armed assailant outside the Israeli embassy in Belgrade after being attacked with two knives and wounded in the left cheek. Outgoing Interior Minister Ivica Dacic stated that the attacker rushed the guard house while shouting religious phrases. Following the incident, Serbia raised its security threat level to red and increased police presence at key locations across the country.
articles.description: It is the second such attack at the Israeli embassy in Belgrade in two years. In June 2024, an ‌assailant shot a Serbian police officer in the neck with ​a crossbow

articles.headline: India adopts new gene-edited rice varieties to boost yields
articles.title: New genetic tools are breathing fresh life into India’s staple crops
articles.summary: India has approved new rice varieties developed using CRISPR gene-editing technology, becoming the first country to allow farmers to cultivate such strains. Created by public research institutions including the Indian Council of Agricultural Research, varieties like DRR Dhan 100 and Pusa DST Rice 1 offer higher yields, reduced water consumption, and better salinity tolerance, marking a major milestone for agricultural technology and food security.
articles.description: As new tools like apomixis become more widely available and private companies start investing more in Indian seeds, it is as important to think about how our system will adapt to these changes as it is to invest in fundamental research in plant genetics, physiology, development and host-pathogen interactions

articles.headline: Canada and United Arab Emirates sign comprehensive trade deal
articles.title: Canada signs trade deal with UAE in push for non-US markets
articles.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney and Abu Dhabi Crown Prince Sheikh Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan signed the Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement to lower trade barriers and boost investment. The pact aims to eliminate tariffs on over 99 percent of Canadian exports to the United Arab Emirates and address non-tariff measures. The agreement forms part of Carney's broader strategy to expand non-US trade amid ongoing economic tensions with Washington.
articles.description: The agreement aims to cut tariffs, reduce red tape and improve market access for businesses in both countries.

articles.headline: Is AIPAC losing its grip on US politics?
articles.title: Is AIPAC losing its grip on US politics?
articles.description: Pro-Israel lobby, AIPAC, is changing its strategy, ending candidate endorsements and direct campaign contributions.

articles.headline: Kenyan family protests extradition hearing delay for former soldier
articles.title: Anger in Kenya over extradition hearing delay for ex-British soldier accused of murdering woman
articles.summary: Relatives of Agnes Wanjiru expressed outrage after a UK extradition hearing for Robert James Purkiss, a former British soldier accused of murdering her in 2012, was postponed until May 2027. The victim's niece criticized the lack of official explanation. Purkiss denies the allegation and is fighting extradition from the United Kingdom to face trial in Kenya.

articles.headline: Tennis player Novak Djokovic praises Serbia student movement election victory

articles.headline: Ministry amends motor vehicle rules to permit ethanol-based fuels up to one hundred percent

articles.summary: The Ministry of Road Transport and Highways amended the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989, to allow vehicles to use fuels containing up to 100 percent ethanol. articles.description: The King is on a nine-day tour that will take him to three countries, including the Bahamas, Guyana and Antigua and Barbuda.
